name: @pipeworx/mcp-mn-drug-price-transparency

tools.name: mn_rx_price_growth
tools.description: Minnesota manufacturer disclosures of a prescription drug's Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC — published list price) increasing — filed under Minnesota's Prescription Drug Price Transparency program (Minn. Stat. 62J.84) with the Department of Health. Search by drug name/fragment, manufacturer, or NDC. Returns the WAC after the increase, the percent increase over the previous WAC, and the manufacturer's stated price-increase factors when disclosed. This is a periodic snapshot (not a live feed) — the response carries `data_as_of`. California has a richer, live-queried equivalent — see ca-drug-price-transparency. Keyless.

drug.description: Drug name or fragment, matched against the drug description.

ndc.description: National Drug Code, any common format.

tools.name: mn_rx_new_drug_launches
tools.description: Minnesota manufacturer disclosures of a NEW prescription drug launched above Minnesota's reporting threshold — filed under the same Prescription Drug Price Transparency program (Minn. Stat. 62J.84) as mn_rx_price_growth, but for a drug's LAUNCH price rather than a later increase. Search by drug name/fragment or manufacturer. Returns the launch WAC and any breakthrough-therapy/priority-review FDA designation. Periodic snapshot — the response carries `data_as_of`. Keyless.

drug.description: Drug name or fragment, matched against the drug description.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-mn-drug-price-transparency forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the mn-drug-price-transparency pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
